content.text: The ghealth credentials are present, so I'll connect using them.

No, the Google connection doesn't work yet. It is not connected.

The ghealth credentials loaded and Google granted all 12 read-only scopes (activity, sleep, heart-related metrics, nutrition, symptoms, profile, and others). But the test request failed with `ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED`, which means the Google account behind those credentials has no linked Google Health identity. The credentials are valid; the account they belong to isn't set up for Google Health data.

I haven't retried or tried the browser sign-in, since that would open a consent flow on your machine. Some options:

1. **Link the account in Google Health.** Make sure the Google account used with ghealth has Google Health set up and linked. Then run `ghealth auth login` to refresh the credentials and I'll try again.
2. **Try a browser sign-in.** I can run the browser connection instead. Tell me if you want that, and make sure you sign in with the Google account that has Google Health data.
3. **Use a Google Takeout export.** If API access stays blocked, I can import a Takeout or Fitbit export instead. That works without API access.

Also note that Google is not onboarding new projects, and while the consent screen is in Testing mode, refresh tokens expire after 7 days. If the connection works but later stops, run `ghealth auth login` again.
